claims.text: No members have signed long-term computing commitments.
claims.rationale: Assignment starting fact; no signed demand dataset provided.
claims.uncertainty: Assignment starting fact; no signed demand dataset provided.

claims.text: Utility price, required upgrades and energization date are unknown.
claims.rationale: Utility offer required before investment approval.
claims.uncertainty: Utility offer required before investment approval.

claims.text: Baseline is 20 MW IT, PUE 1.25 and 25 MW facility load.
claims.rationale: Assignment baseline; PUE is not measured.
claims.uncertainty: Assignment baseline; PUE is not measured.

claims.text: Full-load annual energy is 219 GWh: 20 × 1.25 × 8760 / 1000.
claims.rationale: Nameplate energy, not modeled operating consumption.
claims.uncertainty: Nameplate energy, not modeled operating consumption.

claims.text: CRU published a proposed connection policy in February 2025, including location and generation considerations.
claims.rationale: Final-policy status remains unresolved; proposal is not enforced-rule proof.
claims.uncertainty: Final-policy status remains unresolved; proposal is not enforced-rule proof.

claims.text: Fingrid reported southern connection capacity constraints; storage restrictions extend to 2029, with consumption restrictions previously announced to early 2027.
claims.rationale: Check latest operator policy and individual site; storage capacity is not datacenter capacity.
claims.uncertainty: Check latest operator policy and individual site; storage capacity is not datacenter capacity.

claims.text: Hydro-Québec proposed a new tariff for data centres over 5 MW; projects remain subject to selection.
claims.rationale: Proposed average CAD 0.13/kWh subject to approval; not used as a confirmed delivered tariff.
claims.uncertainty: Proposed average CAD 0.13/kWh subject to approval; not used as a confirmed delivered tariff.

claims.text: Data centres represented 22% of metered electricity consumption in 2024.
claims.rationale: Historical national ecosystem measure; not comparable to a facility count.
claims.uncertainty: Historical national ecosystem measure; not comparable to a facility count.

claims.text: Statistics Finland reports 95% fossil-free electricity production in 2024.
claims.rationale: Annual domestic production; includes nuclear. No 24/7 matching claim.
claims.uncertainty: Annual domestic production; includes nuclear. No 24/7 matching claim.

claims.text: Demand forecast is 64,197,572.4 productive H100-equivalent GPU-hours per year.
claims.rationale: Derived once from baseline capacity: floor(18000/1.4) × 0.95 × 8760 × 0.60. Fixed across scale scenarios; uncommitted.
claims.uncertainty: Derived once from baseline capacity: floor(18000/1.4) × 0.95 × 8760 × 0.60. Fixed across scale scenarios; uncommitted.

claims.text: Costs are illustrative: facility USD 8m/MW; GPU USD 30k; lease USD 3/productive hour; delivered power IRL .15, FIN .10, CAN .10 USD/kWh.
claims.rationale: Constant 2026 USD; no utility/vendor quote or FX claim. These identical Canada/Finland values are assumptions, not country rankings.
claims.uncertainty: Constant 2026 USD; no utility/vendor quote or FX claim. These identical Canada/Finland values are assumptions, not country rankings.

claims.text: Hybrid owns 50% initially and expands at start of year 4, subject to grid availability.
claims.rationale: Fixed comparison schedule, not optimized.
claims.uncertainty: Fixed comparison schedule, not optimized.

claims.text: Reserve 20% of allocation for smaller institutions; teaching reservations, research quotas and overflow are proposed.
claims.rationale: No consortium agreement; independent board resolves conflicts and admits members.
claims.uncertainty: No consortium agreement; independent board resolves conflicts and admits members.

claims.text: Indicative research region: greater Dublin, chosen to investigate ecosystem and constrained-grid tradeoffs.
claims.rationale: No parcel selected; permits and utility offer unknown.
claims.uncertainty: No parcel selected; permits and utility offer unknown.

claims.text: Indicative research region: Helsinki/Uusimaa, chosen to investigate connectivity against southern-grid constraints.
claims.rationale: No claim of unconstrained capacity.
claims.uncertainty: No claim of unconstrained capacity.

claims.text: Indicative research region: Montréal/Québec, chosen to investigate provincial allocation and tariff conditions.
claims.rationale: Provincial evidence must not be generalized to Canada.
claims.uncertainty: Provincial evidence must not be generalized to Canada.

claims.text: Operating power uses 35% idle fraction, with 95% usable hours and 60% productive utilization.
claims.rationale: Coarse power curve, not telemetry; usable fraction applied once.
claims.uncertainty: Coarse power curve, not telemetry; usable fraction applied once.

claims.text: Equivalent leased throughput, egress, reservation guarantees and security remain unverified.
claims.rationale: Uniform H100 GPU-hour pricing does not prove workload equivalence.
claims.uncertainty: Uniform H100 GPU-hour pricing does not prove workload equivalence.

claims.text: No uptime guarantee: 48-hour critical operation requires fuel, cooling and network validation.
claims.rationale: UPS ride-through alone does not establish 48-hour availability.
claims.uncertainty: UPS ride-through alone does not establish 48-hour availability.

claims.text: CRU announced its final connection policy on 12 December 2025. New connections require local or onsite generation/storage matching maximum import demand, plus at least 80% annual demand from additional renewable projects in Ireland with a six-year glide path.
claims.rationale: Final announcement supersedes the February consultation status. These are policy conditions, not an approved project or capacity offer.
claims.uncertainty: Location constraints, implementing process and a project-specific connection offer remain unverified.
